label: Illustration
tagline: Curated illustration-style art-direction for raster-foreground slots
description: Picks illustration styles for raster-foreground slots (and depictive vector-mark slots) BEFORE visual-orchestrator's per-medium dispatch fires. Sibling of photography-orchestrator — same shape, illustration library instead. Reads docs/research/illustration-library.md (108 curated styles across 9 categories: 3D — clay / fluffy / plastic / wireframe / origami / voxel / isometric-tech / Pixar-render; flat-vector — corporate-memphis / thick-border / hairline / geometric / Jean-Jullien; hand-drawn — scribble / ink-line / pencil / watercolor / gouache; anime — Ghibli / Shinkai / shoujo-line / kawaii-mascot; illustrative typography — y2k-chrome / Weingart / Vectorheart / hand-lettered-editorial; abstract-decoration — gradient-blob / doodle-arrow / halftone-shape; mid-century — Saul-Bass / Mary-Blair / Charley-Harper; surreal-esoteric — Hilma-af-Klint / MC-Escher / Cyriak / Beeple). For each illustrative slot, picks one primary + optional secondary style by consulting the library's decision tree against the committed prototype.md aesthetic, writes a prompt-enrichment node (pe_illust_<slotId>) whose outputs include the full prompt, negative-prompt, material hint, line hint, color hint, role hint. Visual-orchestrator reads these enrichments when dispatching raster-foreground. OPTIONAL — fires only when (a) at least one slot will resolve to illustrative raster (raster-foreground with depictive role, or depictive vector-mark) AND (b) an image-generation skill is wired. Distinguishes itself from photography-orchestrator by aesthetic boundary: claymorphism → 3D clay illustrations; corporate-memphis → flat noodle-people; doodle-ui → hand-drawn icons; positivity-kawaii → kawaii mascots — never photographic. Logo / brand-mark vector-marks and Tabler-shaped vector-icons DO NOT route through this orchestrator; they go straight to their per-medium drawers with brand-specific prompts. Cold-isolated per project.

triggers.title: Illustration art-direction pass (BEFORE visual-orchestrator)
triggers.rule: After source HTML is scaffolded (by /prototype skill or top-level Claude), BEFORE visual-orchestrator's per-medium dispatch fires, chat-Claude dispatches illustration-orchestrator IF (a) at least one slot in the source will resolve to raster-foreground with depictive role (mascot / character / spot illustration / hero illustration), OR to depictive vector-mark (multi-figure scene, character mark), AND the surrounding aesthetic demands illustration NOT photography (claymorphism, neumorphism, corporate-memphis, positivity-kawaii, doodle-ui, pixel-*, cottagecore-illustration, dreamcore-illustration, scrapbook-handlettering, aesthetic-curly-girly, aesthetic-vector-neovectorheart, aesthetic-vector-vectorbloom, etc.) AND (b) an image-generation model is wired into the project. Also fires on explicit user request naming an illustration style ("3D clay models" / "fluffy 3D" / "watercolor anime" / "Pixar render" / "Risograph" / "Saul Bass" / "Lisa Frank" / "Hilma af Klint" / "Naoshi Komi" / "Studio Ghibli backgrounds"). One consistent flow. If conditions fail, returns runStatus:error and visual-orchestrator proceeds with default prompts.
